svg.text: CypherMonkey · Webex Lab · not a vendor document
Salesforce — Lightning connector. No chat or email on that article.
Dynamics — CIF 1 or CIF 2. Not Dynamics 365 Contact Center the product.
Recording webhooks — telephony_calls events and convergedRecordings. Scope spark-admin:calls_read.
Personal webhook cap — The Canon quotes 30,000 personal webhooks per user and an org-wide limit of 1. That is the Webhooks guide, not a WxCC task quota.
